name: search-one-precharge
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();print('LIVE', (p/'search-budget.json').read_text());print('LEDGER',(p/'search-charges.jsonl').read_text() if (p/'search-charges.jsonl').exists() else 'absent')
plan={'queries':['"parking spaces" "nonreduced" counterexample','"parking conjectures" "Strong" correction','"parking locus" "non-generic"'],'purpose':'Later distinct-work correction and exceptional hsop navigation; no closed-work recovery'}
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'search-one-plan.json'],input=json.dumps(plan),text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0,z.stderr
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'charge_search.py'),'search-one-plan.json'],capture_output=True,text=True);print(z.stdout);assert z.returncode==0,z.stderr
